text: BERLIN taz ■ Einfach war der Kampf um die Einhaltung von Menschenrechten noch nie Seit den Ereignissen vom 11 September aber ist er noch schwieriger geworden Das betonte die Generalsekretärin von amnesty international ai bei der Vorstellung des Jahresberichts der Organisation gestern in Berlin Viele Regierungen nutzten die Ereignisse des 11 Septembers dafür Menschenrechte zu beschneiden oder zu verletzen erklärte Barbara Lochbihler Vor allem in den USA rücke der Menschenrechtsschutz nach dem Attentat auf das World Trade Center in den Hintergrund Mehr als 1200 Personen seien bei der Suche nach den Attentätern verhaftet und interniert worden Teilweise seien diese Personen auch heute noch ohne Anklage und Prozess unbefristet in Haft Auch die Behandlung der gefangenen Taliban und AlQuaidaKämpfer verstoße gegen internationale Rechtstandards Den Gefangenen in der Militärbasis Guantánamo werde jeder rechtliche Beistand verwehrt Auf die Bitte an die USRegierung die Gefangenen besuchen zu dürfen habe ai bis heute noch keine Antwort erhalten kritisierte die Generalsekretärin Auch in anderen Ländern sei die universelle Gültigkeit von Menschenrechten im Zuge der „Terrorismusbekämpfung“ unter Druck geraten betonte Lochbihler und verwies unter anderem auf die Lage in Kolumbien Dort begingen Armee Paramilitär und oppositionelle Gruppen schwere Menschenrechtsverletzungen 2001 seien dort 153 Gewerkschafter ermordert worden – mehr als in irgendeinem anderen Staat Insgesamt bietet der Jahresbericht für das Jahr 2002 einen Überblick über die Lage der Menschenrechte in 152 Ländern Er dokumentiert außergerichtliche Hinrichtungen in 47 Ländern Folter und Misshandlungen von staatlicher Seite in 111 Ländern und „verschwundene“ Personen in 35 Ländern ANGELIKA HENSOLT
translation: BERLIN taz ■ The fight for human rights has never been easy Since the events of 11 September, however, it has become even more difficult This was emphasised by the Secretary General of Amnesty International (ai) at the presentation of the organisation's annual report in Berlin yesterday Many governments used the events of 11 September to curtail or violate human rights, explained Barbara Lochbihler. In the USA in particular, human rights protection was pushed into the background after the attack on the World Trade Center More than 1200 people were arrested and interned in the search for the attackers Some of these people are still being detained indefinitely without charge or trial The treatment of the captured Taliban and Al-Qaeda fighters also violates international legal standards The prisoners at the Guantánamo military base are denied any legal assistance The Secretary General criticised the fact that ai has still not received a response to the request to the US government to visit the prisoners In other countries, too, the universal validity of human rights has come under pressure in the course of the "fight against terrorism" Lochbihler emphasised and referred to the situation in Colombia, among other things The army, paramilitaries and opposition groups are committing serious human rights violations there. In 2001, 153 trade unionists were murdered there - more than in any other country Overall, the annual report for 2002 provides an overview of the human rights situation in 152 countries It documents extrajudicial executions in 47 countries Torture and ill-treatment by the state in 111 countries and "disappeared" persons in 35 countries ANGELIKA HENSOLT

text: JakartaBonnLissabon tazrtrdpa – Für den Sprecher der osttimoresischen Unabhängigkeitsbewegung ist es ein Fall von „typischer deutscher Heuchelei“ In der Nacht zum Dienstag haben Angestellte der deutschen Botschaft in Jakarta acht bis neun asylsuchende osttimoresische Flüchtlinge vor die Tür gesetzt – direkt in die Arme indonesischer Militärs Just zu diesem Zeitpunkt habe Bundesaußenminister Klaus Kinkel bei der UNO Menschenrechtstagung in Genf viel über Menschenrechte gesprochen sagte Ramos Horta gestern Doch das deutsche Botschaftspersonal habe die Flüchtlinge an jene „Kräfte der Unterdrückung übergeben“ die Kinkel verurteilt habe Laut Augenzeugen waren 9 Flüchtlinge aus OstTimor durch das Haupttor der deutschen Botschaft gelangt und hatten dort Asyl beantragt Doch anstatt ihnen Unterschlupf zu gewähren vertrieb das Sicherheitspersonal die Flüchtlinge Indonesische Soldaten nahmen die OstTimoresen mit gewohnter Brutalität in Empfang Nach Augenzeugenberichten wurden mindestens vier vor dem Botschaftsgelände auf den Boden gedrückt einer wurde geschlagen und am Kopf verletzt Andere Botschaften in Jakarta pflegen einen humaneren Umgang Seit September gelang es 72 OstTimoresen die Ausreise nach Portugal durchzusetzen indem sie auf das Gelände verschiedener ausländischer Botschaften vordrangen und Asyl beantragten In Portugal werden OstTimoresen als Staatsbürger mit vollen Rechten aufgenommen Indonesien hatte die frühere portugiesische Kolonie 1975 besetzt und kurz darauf annektiert was von der UNO nie anerkannt wurde Proteste von Bewohnern OstTimors wurden von indonesischen Militärs und Polizisten wiederholt blutig niedergeschlagen Das Auswärtige Amt AA in Bonn bestätigte gestern den Vorfall sprach aber nur von acht Flüchtlingen Laut AA sind zwei der Abgewiesenen wieder auf freiem Fuß Die deutsche Botschaft gehe davon aus daß die anderen nach der Vernehmung freigelassen würden Anders sieht das amnesty international ai Die OstTimoresen seien direkt dem indonesischen Militär ausgeliefert worden obwohl ihnen dort offensichtlich Folter und schlechte Behandlung drohten Von „unmenschlichem Verhalten“ und einem „moralischen Bankrott der sogenannten Menschenrechtspolitik der Bundesregierung“ sprechen deutsche Solidaritätsgruppen Als vor sieben Jahren BürgerInnen der DDR in bundesdeutsche Botschaften in Budapest und Prag geflüchtet seien „war es eine Selbstverständlichkeit alle diplomatischen Hebel in Bewegung zu setzen damit diese Menschen nicht in eine Situation zurückversetzt werden der sie berechtigterweise zu entfliehen versuchten“ heißt es in einer Erklärung der Arbeitsgruppe für Menschenrechte Demokratie und Umweltschutz aus Heidelberg und der Initiative für die Menschenrechte aller BürgerInnen der AseanStaaten in Frankfurt Gerade die Bundesrepublik Deutschland „sollte sich dazu verpflichtet fühlen sich für unfreiwillige Botschaftsflüchtlinge einzusetzen“ Die Auslieferung sei „ein weiteres Zugeständnis der deutschen Regierung an die technokratische Militärregierung“
translation: JakartaBonnLisbon tazrtrtrdpa - For the spokesman of the East Timorese independence movement, it is a case of "typical German hypocrisy" On Tuesday night, employees of the German embassy in Jakarta threw eight to nine asylum-seeking East Timorese refugees out the door - directly into the arms of Indonesian military forces. German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel had spoken a lot about human rights at the UN Human Rights Conference in Geneva, Ramos Horta said yesterday But the German embassy staff had handed the refugees over to the "forces of oppression" that Kinkel had condemned According to eyewitnesses, nine refugees from East Timor had entered the main gate of the German embassy and applied for asylum there. But instead of giving them shelter, the security personnel drove the refugees away Indonesian soldiers received the East Timorese with their usual brutality According to eyewitness reports, at least four were pushed to the ground in front of the embassy grounds one was beaten and injured in the head Other embassies in Jakarta have a more humane approach. Since September, 72 East Timorese have managed to leave for Portugal by forcing their way onto the premises of various foreign embassies and applying for asylum In Portugal, East Timorese are accepted as citizens with full rights Indonesia occupied the former Portuguese colony in 1975 and annexed it shortly afterwards, which was never recognised by the UN. Protests by residents of East Timor were repeatedly and bloodily suppressed by the Indonesian military and police The German Foreign Office in Bonn confirmed the incident yesterday, but only spoke of eight refugees According to the AA, two of those rejected are at large again The German embassy assumes that the others will be released after questioning The East Timorese were handed over directly to the Indonesian military although they were obviously threatened with torture and poor treatment there German solidarity groups speak of "inhumane behaviour" and a "moral bankruptcy of the German government's so-called human rights policy". When citizens of the GDR fled to German embassies in Budapest and Prague seven years ago, "it was a matter of course to pull out all the diplomatic stops so that these people would not be put back into a situation from which they were legitimately trying to escape", according to a statement by the Working Group for Human Rights, Democracy and Environmental Protection from Heidelberg and the Initiative for Human Rights, Democracy and Environmental Protection from Heidelberg. and Environmental Protection Working Group from Heidelberg and the Initiative for the Human Rights of All Citizens of the Asean States in Frankfurt The Federal Republic of Germany in particular "should feel obliged to stand up for involuntary embassy refugees" The extradition was "a further concession by the German government to the technocratic military government"

text: Berlin taz – Wegen Differenzen über den Umgang mit Menschenrechtsverletzungen in Israel hat die IsraelPalästinaKoordinationsgruppe der deutschen Sektion von amnesty international ai ihre Arbeit nach nur einem Jahr eingestellt Die für dieses Jahr geplante IsraelKampagne wurde abgesagt Zwischen dem aiBundesvorstand der einen vorsichtigen Kurs gegenüber Israel befürwortet und einigen propalästinensisch eingestellten Mitgliedern der Gruppe gab es in den vergangenen Monaten harte Auseinandersetzungen „Die eklatanten Menschenrechtsverletzungen in Israel erfordern ein entschlossenes Vorgehen ohne falsche Rücksichtnahme auf die historische Schuld der Deutschen“ erklärt Andrea Malorny Die frühere Sprecherin der Koordinationsgruppe ist inzwischen mit zwei anderen Mitgliedern bei ai ausgetreten Gegenüber Israel werde von der deutschen aiSektion eine defensive Vorgehensweise praktiziert die gegenüber den PalästinenserInnen nicht mehr vertretbar sei Malorny wirft dem aiVorstand „Passivität Lethargie und Wegsehen“ gegenüber der Situation der PalästinenserInnen vor Für aiVorstandsmitglied Volkmar Deile geht es nicht darum ob menschenrechtliche Forderungen gegenüber Israel erhoben werden sondern wie es getan wird „Die deutsche Sektion hat Verständnis für jeden Juden und jede Jüdin die nicht von deutscher Seite für Menschenrechtsverletzungen durch die israelische Regierung kritisiert werden möchten“ sagt Deile Außerdem stelle sich die Frage „ob es den Opfern von Menschenrechtsverletzungen hilft wenn sich auch Deutsche für sie einsetzen“ Dies sei von der deutschen aiSektion bisher stets bejaht worden „Wir haben die menschenrechtliche Substanz der Kritik an Menschenrechtsverletzungen in der Verantwortung der israelischen Regierung nie relativiert“ Dies belegten 44 Eilaktionen seit 1994 Beiträge im aiJournal und Berichte an die Presse Deile verweist zudem auf einen noch heute gültigen aiBeschluß von 1989 wo festgeschrieben ist „aufgrund der deutschen Geschichte gibt es besondere Beziehungen zu Israel“ Ausschlaggebend für den Streit mit der Koordinationsgruppe seien weniger politische als persönliche Differenzen gewesen In einem offenen Brief halten die ehemaligen Mitglieder der Koordinationsgruppe dagegen Israel sei das einzige Land der Welt in dem es nicht nur „gewöhnliche“ Menschenrechtsverletzungen wie willkürlichen Verhaftungen und unfaire Gerichtsverfahren gebe sondern auch aufgrund einer Entscheidung des Obersten Gerichtshofs 14 November 1996 eine Legalisierung der Folter „Danach ist bei Verhören die Anwendung erhöhten physischen Drucks‘ gestattet wenn die öffentliche Sicherheit gefährdet scheint“ Andrea Malorny kommt zu dem Schluß „IsraelArbeit ist bei aiDeutschland nicht machbar“ Die Länderbeauftragte von ai Margit Jost versichert „Wir werden aber nach wie vor zum Thema Israel arbeiten“ Allerdings könne in diesem Jahr durch das Auseinanderbrechen der Koordinationsgruppe die Kampagne nicht wie vorgesehen durchgeführt werden Man werde sich daher auf die Arbeit der ausländischen aiSektionen verlassen und deren Material verbreiten Jens Rübsam
translation: Berlin taz - Due to differences over how to deal with human rights violations in Israel, the Israel-Palestine Coordination Group of the German section of Amnesty International (ai) has ceased its work after only one year The Israel campaign planned for this year has been cancelled. "The blatant human rights violations in Israel require decisive action without false consideration for the historical guilt of the Germans," explains Andrea Malorny The former spokesperson of the coordination group has since resigned from ai along with two other members. The German ai section has adopted a defensive approach towards Israel that is no longer justifiable towards the Palestinians Malorny accuses the ai board of "passivity, lethargy and turning a blind eye" to the situation of the Palestinians For ai board member Volkmar Deile, the issue is not whether human rights demands are made towards Israel, but how they are met. "The German section has sympathy for every Jew who does not want to be criticised by the German side for human rights violations by the Israeli government," says Deile In addition, the question arises "whether it helps the victims of human rights violations if Germans also stand up for them" This has always been answered in the affirmative by the German ai section "We have never relativised the human rights substance of the criticism of human rights violations under the responsibility of the Israeli government" This is evidenced by 44 urgent actions since 1994, articles in the ai journal and reports to the press Deile also refers to an ai resolution from 1989 that is still valid today, where it states The decisive factor in the dispute with the Coordination Group was not so much political as personal differences In an open letter, the former members of the Coordination Group argue that Israel is the only country in the world where there are not only "ordinary" human rights violations such as arbitrary arrests and unfair trials, but also the legalisation of torture on the basis of a Supreme Court ruling of 14 November 1996 "According to this ruling, the use of 'increased physical pressure' is permitted during interrogations if public safety appears to be at risk" Andrea Malorny concludes "IsraelWork is not feasible in aGermany". ai's country representative Margit Jost assures "We will, however, continue to work on the topic of Israel" However, due to the break-up of the coordination group, the campaign cannot be carried out as planned this year We will therefore rely on the work of the foreign ai sections and disseminate their material Jens Rübsam

text: Fransanın doğusundaki Alsas bölgesine bahar çoktan gelmiş Avenue de Colmar Strazburg şehir merkezinin dışında kalıyor Burada 1970’lerde yapılmış binalarda yaşayan çok sayıda göçmen var Binanın önündeki park alanı bir çitle ikiye ayrılmış Elleri arkalarında sigaraları ağızlarında üç adam binanın önünde volta atıyor Güvenlik görevlisi olmak için çok yaşlı da olsalar yine de nöbet tutuyorlar Kapıyı üç adamdan biri açıyor Eskiden otomobil ekspertiz ofisi olan bu yerde artık açlık grevine girmiş olan insanlar kalıyor Yüksel Koçun da aralarında bulunduğu 14 kişi Abdullah Öcalan’ın “tecrit işkencesi“ni protesto etmek için 17 Aralık 2018 tarihinden beri açlık grevinde Farklı ülkelerde yaşayan yüzlerce insanın açlık grevine girdiği söyleniyor Eylemcilerin talebi hapisteki liderlerinin PKKnin kurucusu Abdullah Öcalan’ın ailesinin ve avukatlarının onu yeniden düzenli olarak ziyaret etmesine izin verilmesi Avrupa İnsan Hakları Mahkemesi İşkencenin Önlenmesi Avrupa Komitesi’nin merkezi Strazburg’da olduğu için eylem burada yapılıyor İşkence karşıtı komite Mart 2018’de Öcalan’ın içinde bulunduğu tecrit koşullarını kınamıştı Avrupa Konseyi de benzer bir karar aldı ancak PKK’ye yakın Kürtler açısından bu girişimler yeterli değil Girişte “Otomobil ekspertizi“ yazılı bir levha asılı Altı kişinin durduğu antredeki resepsiyon bankosunun üzerinde dezenfektan bağış kutusu ve solup gitmiş çiçek demetleri var Açlık grevindekilerin en genci 27 en yaşlısı 58 yaşında Yan odada duvar büyüklüğünde bir pankart asılı grevcilerin ilk günkü hallerini gösteriyor Hepsi üzerlerinde Abdullah Öcalan’ın resmi olan yelekler giymiş Başka bir duvarda şimdiye kadar grevde geçen günleri saymak için çizik attıkları bir levha bulunuyor Altında da “Liderimiz Apo çok yaşa“ yazıyor Peki ya kendileri ne kadar yaşayacak Adamlardan biri bana bir sandalye hazırlıyor bir diğeri bir çay bardağı uzatıp dışarı çıkıyor Birkaç dakika sonra geri gelip içeri girebileceğimi belirtiyorlar Üç grev odasından birine giden camlı kapıda PKK bayrağı asılı Karton bir levhaya keçeli kalemle Kürtçe “Giriş için izin gereklidir“ ve “Yüksek sesle konuşmayın“ yazılmış Odanın ışığı loş Duvarlar beyaz zemin karolu altı tane metal karyola Ikea nevresimleri her yerde dolu ve boş su şişeleri var etraf temizlik malzemesi kokuyor Duvarlarda ölen gerillaların fotoğrafları asılı Odadaki herkesin ağzında maske var Oda bir hastanenin karantina servisini andırıyor Yüksel Koç da içeride yatıyor Koç ile yaklaşık 15 sene önce tanıştım O zamanlar Bremen’de bir paket servis şirketinin forklift şoförü olarak çalışıyordu Şehirdeki Kürt derneğinin başkanıydı Dernek Bremen’deki Kürdistan İşçi Partisi’nin PKK yasal koluydu Kürtler Bremen’de bir zorluk yaşadığında lobi faaliyetlerini üstlenerek basınla konuşan gösteriler düzenleyen avukatları bulan her seferinde Koç olurdu Ardından önce PKK’ye yakın Almanya Demokratik Kürt Toplum Kongresi temsilcisi ardından da Avrupa Demokratik Kürt Toplum Kongresi başkan yardımcısı oldu Koç’u en son Temmuz 2017’de Hamburg’ta görmüştüm Türkiye Cumhurbaşkanı Tayyip Erdoğan G20 zirvesi için şehre gelecekti Kürtler bir protesto eylemi düzenlediler Ancak Koç orada uzun süre kalamadı Birkaç ay evvel federal savcılık MİT adına Koç’a suikast girişimi planı yapan bir kişiyi tutuklamıştı Koç o zamandan bu yana izlenmesi daha zor olsun diye sürekli hareket halindeydi Kim bilir nasıl değişmiştir diye kendi kendime soruyorum Ancak her zamanki gibi görünüyor Kalın bıyığı ve seyrek saçları var kısa bir adam Elimi tokalaşmak için kaldırdığı eline uzatıyorum Nasıl olduğunu sorarken sesimin yüksek çıkmasından korkuyorum Koç kafasını sallıyor Yoğun bakımdaki bir hasta gibi nefes alıyor Muhtemelen olması gereken yer de orası Yatağının yanında küçük bir komodinin üzerinde beş kitap Cumhuriyet davası kapsamında 360 gündür Silivri Cezaevinde tutulan Cumhuriyet Gazetesi Genel Yayın Yönetmeni Murat Sabuncunun doğum günü Sabuncu cezaevinden paylaştığı mesajda kendisi için en güzel doğum günü hediyesinin „bugün davası görülen hak savunucularının özgürlüklerine kavuşması olacağını“ söyledi Bizler de Murat Sabuncunun en kısa zamanda özgürlüğüne kavuşmasını diliyor ve doğum gününü kutluyoruz 
Murat Sabuncunun oğlu Muratcan Sabuncu Cesaret bulmaya devam edeceğiz
 Canım babam bir yıla yaklaşan tutukluluğunda pek çok önemli günde birlikte olamadık bugün doğum gününde de birlikte değiliz Siyasi çıkarlar uğruna belirsizliklere teslim edilmiş bir ülkede yeni yaşının getireceklerini öngörebilmem mümkün değil Yine de bugün tutacağın dileği biliyorum özgür demokratik ve aydınlık bir Türkiye Bugün seni ziyaret etmem ya da telefon etmem mümkün değil Olsun senin de benim başımızı kaldırdığımızda baktığımız gökyüzü aynı Haklısın gökyüzünü görebilmen için bakışlarının penceredeki demir parmaklıkları ve havalandırma kafesindeki çelik telleri aşması gerekiyor Şundan emin olabilirsin hepimiz bugün tutacağın dileği gökyüzünde görüp gülümseyeceğiz dik duruşunuzdan cesaret bulmaya devam edeceğiz Sana bugün hediye veremiyorum ama Türkiye hayallerinin bir parçası olacağıma ve senin gibi sadece gerçeklerin peşinde olacağıma söz veriyorum Ellerinden öperim 
Cumhuriyet gazetesi yazarı Aydın Engin Çık avluya keyifli bir doğum günü voltası at
 Müdürüm yayın yönetmenim Bugün senin doğum günün Sana bugün izin veriyoruzSabahın köründe kalkma “Bebek Kahve“ye oturup bir yandan tost kemirip bir yandan bütün gazeteleri ilk sayfadan son sayfaya okuma Kargalar kahvaltı etmeden yazıişleri ve haberciler henüz gelmemişken gazeteye damlama Sabah 10 toplantısında servis şefleri editör henüz gözlerini ovuştururken sen günün olası gelişmelerini birer birer sayıp dökme Öğlen toplantısında “tamam“ diye önüne konan haberleri didikleyip “Şuna şunu ekleyin“ diye başımıza yeni yeni işler çıkarıp durma 1500 toplantısında haberlerden birinde kimsenin göremediği ayrıntıyı yakalayıp gazetenin manşetini bulup çıkarma Geceyarısına kadar kalıp gazeteyi habire değiştirip durma Bugün senin doğum günün Sana izin verdik Çık avluya gökyüzüne tel kafeslerin ardından bakıp keyifli bir doğum günü voltası at… 
Cumhuriyet Gazetesi Muhabiri Nazan Özcan Odası lavanta kokardı
 Geçen yıl 25 Ekim’de Murat Sabuncuyu gittim ve yanaklarından öptüm “İyi yaşlar olsun“ dedim sarıldık Utangaç bir sağoldan sonra lavanta kolonyası verdi “Beni rahatlatıyor“ dedi Zaten odası hep lavanta kolonyası kokardı Onun hiç rahatladığını görmedim o ayrı sürekli gazete daha nasıl iyi olur diye uğraşıp dururdu Doğum gününde de öyleydi Bir yıldır odasına çıkmadım çünkü bir yıldır Murat Silivri Cezaevi’nde Odasının bulunduğu kattan dün lavanta kokusu geldi Baktım Murat’a gazetede çektirip yine gazeteye basıp göndereceğimiz “doğum günü resmi“ için annesi eşi ve arkadaşları odada Lavanta kokusu bu sefer beni rahatlattı Sevgili Müdürüm belki doğum gününü kutlayamadık ama sözümüz olsun çıktığın günü kutlayacağız Özgürlüğü kutlayacağız diz çökmeyişimizi ve onurla yaptığımız mesleğimizi kutlayacağız Baskıya hapse adaletsizliğe inat kutlayacağız Hediyen de hazır Lavanta kolonyası 
Cumhuriyet Gazetesi Muhabiri Canan Çoşkun Pastayı üflerken özgürlük diliyoruz

text: FREIBURG taz ■ Wer in Deutschland Asyl bekommen hat soll nicht an den Verfolgerstaat ausgeliefert werden können – auch wenn dieser wohlklingende Zusicherungen macht Das fordert die Menschenrechtsorganisation amnesty international ai Die Organisation hält eine anderslautende Bestimmung des deutschen Asylrechts für verfassungswidrig und beruft sich dabei auf ein Gutachten das der taz vorliegt und heute in Berlin vorgestellt wird Auf den ersten Blick klingt die aiForderung wie eine Selbstverständlichkeit Doch tatsächlich ist die Asylanerkennung im Auslieferungsverfahren nicht verbindlich Dies besagt Paragraf 4 des Asylverfahrensgesetzes Immer wieder fordert deshalb zum Beispiel die Türkei die Auslieferung von asylberechtigten Anhängern der kurdischen PKK um sie in ihrer Heimat wegen Gewalttaten vor Gericht zu stellen oder entsprechende Strafurteile zu vollstrecken Nach türkischen Medienberichten auf die ai verweist existiert eine Liste von rund 60 Personen die aus Deutschland ausgeliefert werden sollen Die Türkei sichert in solchen Fällen zu dass es nur um die Ahndung von generell strafbaren kriminellen Taten gehe nicht aber um politische Verfolgung Für Rechtsprofessor Otto Lagodny sind solche Zusicherungen jedoch „völlig ungeeignet die einmal angenommene politische Verfolgung wieder auszuschließen“ Warum soll bei einem Staat auf die Zusicherung vertraut werden er werde die Menschenrechte respektieren fragt Lagodny in seinem Gutachten wenn dem betroffenen Ausländer doch gerade deshalb Schutz gewährt wird weil ihm von diesem Staat Gefahr droht Auch wenn ein Folterstaat im konkreten Fall zusichert er werde nicht foltern wäre es eine „unmenschliche Behandlung“ den Ausländer an diesen Staat auszuliefern so der RechtshilfeExperte Der Ausländer müsse dann schließlich ständig mit der Angst leben dass die Zusicherung nicht eingehalten wird In der Praxis scheiterten Auslieferungen von Asylberechtigten zuletzt meist aus anderen Gründen Im Fall des Kurden Yusuf Karaca taz vom 10 6 2006 erklärte das Oberlandesgericht Frankfurt im August 2007 dass die Auslieferung unzulässig sei An dem türkischen Strafurteil wegen eines angeblichen Bankraubs das die Türkei nun vollstrecken wollte hätten Militärrichter mitgewirkt „Bis zu dieser Entscheidung saß Karaca aber monatelang in deutscher Auslieferungshaft“ kritisiert Julia Duchrow von ai CHRISTIAN RATH
translation: FREIBURG taz ■ Anyone who has been granted asylum in Germany should not be able to be extradited to the persecuting state - even if the latter makes euphonious assurances This is the demand of the human rights organisation Amnesty International (ai) The organisation considers a contrary provision of German asylum law to be unconstitutional, citing an expert opinion that is available to the taz and will be presented today in Berlin At first glance, the ai demand sounds like a matter of course But in fact, recognition of asylum is not binding in extradition proceedings This is stated in Section 4 of the Asylum Procedure Act Turkey, for example, has repeatedly demanded the extradition of Kurdish PKK supporters entitled to asylum in order to bring them to justice in their home country for acts of violence or to enforce corresponding criminal sentences According to Turkish media reports to which ai refers, there is a list of around 60 people who are to be extradited from Germany Turkey assures in such cases that it is only a matter of punishing generally punishable criminal offences, not political persecution For law professor Otto Lagodny, however, such assurances are "completely unsuitable for ruling out political persecution once it has been assumed." In his expert opinion, Lagodny asks why a state should be trusted with the assurance that it will respect human rights if the foreigner concerned is granted protection precisely because he is threatened with danger by this state Even if a torturing state assures in a specific case that it will not torture, it would be "inhumane treatment" to extradite the foreigner to this state, according to the legal assistance expert. In practice, extraditions of persons entitled to asylum have recently mostly failed for other reasons In the case of the Kurd Yusuf Karaca taz of 10 6 2006, the Frankfurt Higher Regional Court declared in August 2007 that the extradition was inadmissible Military judges had been involved in the Turkish criminal judgement for an alleged bank robbery, which Turkey now wanted to enforce "Until this decision, however, Karaca had been in German extradition custody for months," criticises Julia Duchrow from ai CHRISTIAN RATH

text: London ap  Die Gefangenenhilfsorganisation amnesty international ai wirft SaudiArabien vor von 1983 bis 1989 mehr als 700 Personen ohne Gerichtsurteil aus politischen Gründen inhaftiert und Geständnisse durch Folterungen erpreßt zu haben Foltermethoden seien Schlafentzug Schläge auf die Fußsohlen und Aufhängen an den Handgelenken Vor und während der Vernehmungen würden die Häftlinge zwei Wochen bis sechs Monate in Einzelhaft gehalten ai nennt die Namen von 66 Personen die derzeit ohne Gerichtsurteil in drei Gefängnissen säßen
translation: London ap The prisoners' aid organisation Amnesty International (ai) accuses Saudi Arabia of imprisoning more than 700 people without trial for political reasons between 1983 and 1989 and of torturing them into confessions The torture methods used were sleep deprivation, beatings on the soles of the feet and hanging by the wrists Before and during interrogations, the prisoners were held in solitary confinement for between two weeks and six months ai names 66 people who are currently being held without trial in three prisons

text: Çadırın içinde bir televizyon bir buzdolabı birkaç yorgan var “Çek“ diyor “Nasıl yaşıyoruz direniyoruz görsünler“ Hakkını alana kadar bu çadırdan çıkmayacağını sürekli tekrar eden Mehmet At “Bombalar yağdırdılar perişan ettiler evimizi yıktılar bizi hayattayken öldürdüler Daha ne yapabilirler“ diyor 60 yaşındaki Mehmet At Diyarbakır’ın Sur ilçesindeki Lale Paşa Mahallesi’nde çadırda yaşıyor Çünkü Sur’daki acele kamulaştırma nedeniyle evi ve dükkanı yıkılmış Evinin yıkıldığı yere çadır kurmuş eşi ile birlikte yaşıyor Onun ifadesiyle “hükümete karşı direniyor“ Çocukları ise tanıdıklarının ya da akrabalarının yanlarında kalıyor Doğduğundan beri Sur’da yaşayan ve hurdacılık yaparak 18 kişilik aileye bakan Mehmet At’ın evi ve dükkanı artık yok Devlet bunların karşılığında 38 bin TL para ödemeyi teklif etmiş Evinin arazisine yapılan yeni evlerin değeri ise 500 bin TL O ise günde 10 TL kazanıyor Hesap ortada… Zaten ev de istemiyor Kendisine ait arazisini verseler yeter “Ben evimi yaparım“ diyor Devletten aldığı 500 TL civarında kira yardımı 18 kişiye yetmiyor Taş evleri dar sokakları tarihi ile önemli bir konuma sahip olan Sur kenti nasıl bu hale geldi 2015 yılında öz yönetim talebiyle Sur sokaklarına hendekler kazan milislere karşı Türkiye güvenlik güçlerinin güç kullanmasıyla başladı çatışmalar Sur’un dar sokaklarındaki evler tanklarla yıkıldı Çatışmalar sırasında Sur’da yaşayan halkın bir kısmı evlerini boşalttı bir kısmı zorla çıkartıldı kimileri ise orada kalmayı tercih etti 2015 yılı sonunda „hendek ve barikatların kapatılması bombalı tuzakların kaldırılması“ amacıyla sokağa çıkma yasağı ilan edildi ve pek çok mahalle yıkıldı mart 2016da acele kamulaştırma kararı ile Sur’daki tüm mahalleler kamulaştırıldı Yıkımın olduğu mahallerde yaşayanların eline de “evlerinin ve iş yerlerinin 7 gün içerisinde tahliye etmeleri gerektiği“ yönünde yazı verildi Dicle Toplumsal Araştırmalar Merkezi’nin raporuna göre yerinden edilen aile sayısı 6 binden fazla Evlerinden ayrılan ailelerin bir kısma kira yardımı aldı ancak yapılan yardımda kalabalık ailelere yetmedi Şimdilerle bir yanda Sur halkının kolektif yaşam alanları olan çamaşırhaneler kreşler bir yandan evler okullar sağlık merkezleri mahalleler kısacası kent yaşamı ve tarihinin kalbi yıkılırken diğer yandan etrafı demir bloklarla kapatılan inşaat alanlarında TOKİ Toplu Konut İdaresi Başkanlığı ev yapıyor Bazı sokaklara girmek çatışmaların olduğu yerlerin ve yeni yapılan evlerin fotoğrafını çekmek yasak Yolunuzu kaybedip „girdiğiniz bir sokakta güvenlik güçlerinin sizi gözaltına alma ihtimali çok yüksek“ diye uyarıyor yurttaşlar Hatta „kendi güvenliğiniz için gazeteci olduğunuzu da söylemeyin“ diyorlar Kısaca bugün Sur kentin ortasında üzeri örtülü bir açık yara gibi Tüm bu süreçten Dengbej Evi de payına düşeni aldı Acıların sevinçlerin katliamların ölümlerin yazılan ya da yazılmayan Kürt tarihini klamlarla uzun hava aktaran kişiye deniyor Dengbej Sadece Kürtlere ait olan Dengbejlik Sur için de ayrı bir önem taşıyor Dengbej Evinin binası hala sağlam olsa da orada Kürt tarihini anlatan 26 Dengbej 2016 yılında atanan Kayyum nedeniyle oradan ayrılmak zorunda kaldı Onlardan biri de Âpe Naif’di Tüm bu yasakların arasında Lalepaşa Mahallesi’ndeki bir fırıncıda anlatmaya başlıyor hikayesini Sur’da 2015 yılında başlayan operasyonlarla da iki evini kaybetmiş Operasyonların olduğu dönemde 14 gün boyunca çocuklarıyla evinin mutfağında yaşamış Sonra polisler evden çıkarmış tüm aileyi “Polisler biz çıkarırken çok küfür ettiler çok ağır konuştular Sen burada kalıp onlara Kürt milisler yardım ediyorsun yemek yapıyorsun’ dediler Benim ne kârım vardı ki onlara yardım edeyim“ “Evinden tek parça eşya kıyafet almadan çıkmak zorunda bırakıldığını“ anlatan Apê Naif şimdi kiralık bir evde oturuyor Geçimlik gelirleri ise yok denecek kadar az İş buldukça inşaatlarda çalışıyor “Bir pulum bile yok“ diye ifade ediyor durumunu Dengbejliğe devam ediyor ancak bu yüzden de birçok kez soruşturma geçirmiş “Bana sen Kürtçe politik şarkılar söylüyorsun’ diyorlar Birkaç kere bu yüzden gözaltına bile alındım Ben halk ozanıyım halkım ne isterse onu söylerim“ Çözüm süreci döneminde Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan’ın “Kürt meselesini halledeceğim“ dediğini hatırlatan Apê Naif “Şimdi halkın ciğerlerinden damla damla kan akıyor“ diye bitiriyor hikayesini anlatmayı birinde dinliyoruz Video için tıklayın… Çevre ve Şehircilik Bakanlığı’nın hazırladığı Suriçi Koruma Amaçlı İmar Planı kapsamında Sur’daki dar yollar genişletilecek birbiriyle bağlantılı 6 karakol yapılacak Henüz yıkılmayan mahalleler de kentsel dönüşüm adıyla yıkılacak Yani Apê Naif ve Mehmet At gibi daha pek çok mağduriyet yaşanacak Öyle görünüyor ki binlerce yıllık kentin tarihi bundan sonra sokaklarla evlerle kiliselerle camilerle değil dengbejlerin klamlarıyla anlatılacak

text: Amnesty international hat eine Beendigung der „beschämenden Praxis“ der Hinrichtung jugendlicher Straftäter unter 18 Jahren gefordert Die Hinrichtung ist juristisch zwar noch in mehreren Staaten möglich wird derzeit aber nur in den USA vollzogen Laut ai soll diese Strafe bis zum Jahr 2005 „der Geschichte angehören“ dpa
translation: Amnesty International has called for an end to the "shameful practice" of executing juvenile offenders under the age of 18 The execution is still legally possible in several countries but is currently only carried out in the USA According to ai, this punishment should "belong to history" by 2005 dpa

taz Mr Wolf Mr Lauer Mr Lux Which of you will be the next senator of the interior?
 
Silence
 Christopher Lauer Now comes a typical politician's answer We'll all be glad when Frank Henkel is no longer Senator of the Interior
Typical Lauer pushes his way to the front He also constantly stole the show from you in the Committee on Internal Affairs Mr Lux and Mr Wolf, did that annoy you?
 Udo Wolf He was annoying at times But Christopher deserves great credit He found a dusty paragraph in the rules of procedure of the House of Representatives So together we were able to stop the nationwide video surveillance Great
It had actually already been decided by the red-black Senate Now the SPD parliamentary group had an opportunity to back down here
 Wolf The law would have been a disaster The SPD has realised that it cannot score points with an important part of the red-red-green electorate if the CDU gets away with it Lauer The number of people interested in civil rights in Germany is manageable But they are multipliers Then it would have been "Who betrayed us Social Democrats" again Hopefully the SPD will realise that it cannot win a flower pot if it always runs after the CDU in terms of domestic policy
Why doesn't anyone dare to come out of the woodwork when it comes to the question of Henkel's successor, Mr Lux, otherwise you wouldn't be so reticent?
 Benedikt Lux The interior ministry is very difficult Henkel didn't want it either The ministry has a huge body of personnel there is a backlog of reforms It will also be one of the least attractive in the next coalition
Another politician's blah blah blah
 Lux I got married at the weekend and I'm not yet fit for questioning again laughs But I'm serious about what I said about the interior ministry There have been a lot of personnel disputes and blockades there in recent years it's unclear who is responsible for the civil service, digitalisation and the citizens' offices You can't really shape things there The The departments of urban development, education and finance are a thousand times more interesting Wolf I really enjoy my job as parliamentary group leader and would like to continue doing it The question of which Senate departments we will claim after the election is sensibly at the end of coalition negotiations Journalists should also be aware of this
You're allowed to spin around
 Wolf Of course we are in a position to govern, preferably in a three-party constellation of red-red-green, but there is still a long way to go until then
Let's talk about the police Regardless of the outcome of the election, Klaus Kandt will remain as police commissioner How would you rate him after three years of service?
 Lux Drei minus Lauer He may not be Margarete Koppers, but he apparently works closely with the Vice President I was pleasantly surprised that the police reorganised the approval process for crime-ridden locations on their own initiative This shows Kandt is critical But of course he is also a CDU wolf Klaus Kandt got off to a bad start He talked a lot of nonsense about racial profiling But he is not resistant to advice When civil rights activists pointed out abuses to him from the opposition, he tried to clear them up
Are the police more progressive than their employer Henkel?
 Lux Definitely at least part of the police force
What are the most burning domestic policy issues
 Wolf An independent police commissioner is very important And the de-escalation strategy that has fallen by the wayside in this legislative period
In which places, for example
 Wolf The police literally stormed the Alice Salomon University of Applied Sciences in April during a Nazi demonstration because an anti-right-wing banner was hanging out of the window The rector's offers of mediation were rejected At the same time, the Nazis gave the Hitler salute outside the door - and the police did nothing That was the opposite of de-escalation
Where else
 Wolf The fact that the police raided the Rigaer94 housing project in January with 550 officers without a warrant and now the eviction of the Kadterschmiede, also in Rigaer
What would be your strategy
 Lauer Henkel is doing a Larry and sending in as many police officers as possible to harass people That's not a strategy Under the last senator of the interior, there was a practice of seeking dialogue with radical leftists Henkel says the rule of law is non-negotiable Can you talk to the people in Rigaer Lux I think so
Round tables are supposed to solve the problems - are you serious?
 Lauer No, you need a negotiator who has experience in uniting hostile ethnic groups The people from the alternative housing project, the residents, the district and the state of Berlin - everyone needs an advocate and then you agree on things For example, that the people of Rigaer94 can live there without fear of being evicted
And the residents of the new buildings no longer need to be afraid that their children's rooms will be shot with bullets
 Lauer Exactly The people there know that our yuppie apartment blocks won't have paint thrown at them, our cars won't be set on fire and no windows will be smashed The goal must be peaceful coexistence That sounds pretty old-fashioned today Lux But this is an escalating situation that can only be resolved in a cautionary manner from the opposition. At the moment, the mood on all sides is so poisoned that calm has to be brought into play first One possibility would be to buy the house That worked for many of the formerly squatted houses in Friedrichshain in the early 1990s But you have to have acceptance in the city for that Before the election, it certainly won't work anymore
Mr Wolf Your opinion
 Wolf I agree with my colleagues The prerequisite for even starting a dialogue would be to lift the police occupation of the street As always, the basic principle of peace negotiations applies Unilateral disarmament can increase confidence that the other side will sit down at the table again In addition, one should try to get the police to patrol in such a way that one or two arsonists are caught The Linx special investigation group just founded by Henkel, on the other hand, is completely pointless
When was the last time you were in Rigaer Straße?
 Wolf I don't have to go there I'm not in any executive responsibility I'm probably not a welcome mediator there either Most people from Rigaer think we're traitors in the whole squatter issue anyway Lauer We all agree on that The situation is muddled and should be resolved as quickly as possible That would be the task of the governing mayor Michael Müller You can't wait for the next interior senator
Is it always so harmonious when the three of you get together?
 Lauer We tend to quarrel more in the Interior Committee
You always pass the balls to each other there too
 
General laughter
 Lauer Well, yes, I always tell Green Party MP Canan Bayram that her party abstained on our motion to abolish the crime-ridden areas And now she's campaigning in Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg with great fanfare and says she wants to abolish the so-called danger zones in Berlin
How do you assess the situation in Görlitzer Park since Henkel introduced the zero-tolerance zone there in April 2015?
 Lauer That has hardly achieved anything The few people who have been arrested and the little bit of hashish that has been confiscated You have totally frustrated police officers who are standing there with their legs flat on the ground In other places, they are missing Lux For all the police hours deployed in Görli, you could also have financed a permanent parking patrol with eight people for the entire Görlitzer Park In contrast to the CDU, the Greens, Left Party and Pirates would take a much closer look at how a targeted police operation can be carried out
A recently presented field study says that children and young people avoid the park because of drug dealing and Arab and Turkish families no longer go there
 Lux There is still no Arabic-speaking social worker for Görli And Hasenheide shows that things can be done differently Non-aggressive drug dealing has been tolerated there for decades and the park is still attractive for families Lauer It would be time to talk about a different drug policy in Germany and Europe Not such isolated solutions along the lines of "we're going to open a coffee shop in Kreuzberg", but rather how to legalise hashish and, in case of doubt, how to get harder drugs dispensed legally As someone who, due to ADHD, legally puffs amphetamines on prescription every day, I just laugh at this nonsensical prohibition policy.
But that doesn't solve the current problems on the ground
 Lauer Sorry, but you're making it too easy for yourself I've been a member of parliament in Berlin for five years The policy before that ...
... i.e. the governing coalition of the SPD and the Left Party ...
 Lauer ... ... set an extremely shitty course for many things As a result, drug policy in particular has not gone beyond repression For example, drug dealing was a big issue at Weinbergspark in Mitte in 2011 A citizens' initiative campaigned against it the park was made pretty and the scene moved on That's a travelling circus Wolf Right The only thing that can help against drug-related crime is a change to the Narcotics Act at federal level You can create pressure at state level and decriminalise the possession of soft drugs But as long as the law is in place, domestic policy can't achieve much Such a zero-tolerance approach is nothing but actionism
For the annoyed residents, that's little consolation
 Lauer Of course, something could be done at Kotti if the police weren't used for pointless actions at Görli Berlin hasn't brushed its teeth for decades and now wonders about completely rotten teeth that are much more expensive to replace than if you brushed your teeth every day
How could it be better?
 Lauer The public order office could take the pressure off the police in certain cases, such as road traffic accidents.
And the police also need more staff At least that's what the election manifestos of the Left and the Greens say
 Wolf Yes, Frank Henkel has created a few jobs that he has saved elsewhere - through so-called flat-rate reductions in expenditure So police officers can't show their presence on the streets but sit in the office or have to stand around in property protection That shows what priorities exist in the internal administration
One could have expected the CDU to prioritise getting the police up to scratch
 Lauer But it hasn't The biggest misunderstanding in recent German history is probably that the CDU has any idea about domestic policy Lux Right Lauer They sit down and do nothing - and then after a few years another government consisting of the SPD and someone else has to spoon out the soup
Why didn't you push Henkel more?
 Lauer But we have Just the Left and the Greens have put forward more and more proposals in the budget consultations They have calculated the aforementioned flat-rate under-spending a thousand times Then Senator Henkel always sat there and read off his speech slip "You didn't understand, we're hiring more police officers" That was the political debate And the public is just more interested in riot stories at Görli, Kotti and Rigaer
Now it's the media's fault who prefer to drive a pig through the village
 Lauer Yes - and no Wolf I also find the accusation that the opposition doesn't do this or that incredibly annoying Example of the NSU scandal We drove Henkel and the police up and down We took legal action before the Constitutional Court against the unspeakable surveillance footage of large demonstrations Unfortunately, the judges didn't share our objections And as far as the issue of public service personnel is concerned We presented development concepts that were rejected by the SPD and now, during the election campaign, the SPD is standing up and demanding exactly that
But Henkel has made it easy for you too He is a comparatively weak interior senator
 Lux That's right The CDU and Henkel were completely out of their depth They didn't do much in the way of a law-and-order state But you can't nail pudding to the wall We played the Interior Committee well - and we will soon wish for that time back Three left-wing, civil rights-oriented parliamentary groups that also question the tasks of the state That will change after 18 September
In the next parliamentary term, at least the Left and the Greens will have to deal with the AfD What are you facing?
 Wolf The AfD is a classic national-conservative right-wing split-off from the bourgeois camp, which is largely fuelled by the camp of non-voters We spoke to our colleagues in Brandenburg and Thuringia about what everyday life in parliament with the AfD looks like The work won't be easy
How do you envisage it
 Wolf We already have approximate values Some statements from the CDU by Burkard Dregger or Robbin Juhnke are sometimes close to the AfD programme Lauer Right Wolf Some meetings of the Council of Elders have had to deal with tumults triggered in this way Lauer The House of Representatives is the most opposition-friendly state parliament in Germany Many opposition motions are referred to the committees The discussion times are fairly distributed I am afraid that the very opposition-friendly rules of procedure will be tinkered with because of the AfD - for quite understandable reasons That means that minority rights will be restricted and opposition work will become more difficult Wolf This must not happen under any circumstances Just because enemies of democracy enter parliament, democracy must not be abolished We need a Berlin consensus among the democratic parties, including in their behaviour towards this unsavoury organisation Lux It will be crucial that we mobilise our voters When I hear what the AfD is saying, it simply doesn't make sense to me that they appeal to such a broad spectrum
Mr Lauer, you are leaving parliament - your assessment after five years
 Lauer It's exhausting, totally annoying but a lot of fun The Pirate parliamentary group was able to initiate some meaningful things in Berlin from the opposition I think it's a shame that the topic of politics is treated so little in society despite being so strongly represented in the media Everyone needs to become more political - and state politics is more interesting than you think Wolf I will miss Mr Lauer in the Committee on Internal Affairs and in the plenary Lux Not just him
Mr Lauer, the political establishment will see you again
 Lauer That's when you get the call Lux He's still young

text: Der ambitionierte Film über die Zukunft des Menschen ist ein merkwürdiger Zwitter Einerseits geht einem Peter Kriegs intellektuellreligiöse Geschwätzigkeit ganz schön auf die Nerven dann und wann läßt er aber Leute zu Wort kommen deren phantastischen Visionen man gerne länger lauschen möchte Kriegs These daß wir erst in der Lage sind die wahre Bedeutung von Technik als Wunsch und Angstmaschine zu erkennen wenn wir „unsere innere Realität der Gefühle wahrzunehmen bereit sind„ klingt nach modischem New Age Nicht weniger enervierend ist ein stilisierter „Träumer“ der alle paar Minuten im Film auftaucht und mit Kabeln und Schläuchen an allerlei technisches Gerät angeschlossen ist ein plumpbilliges Abziehbild wie es sich mal wieder nur ein deutscher Filmemacher ausdenken konnte der oberlehrerhaft seine Thesen „illustrieren“ will Der Film wurde vom Fernsehen und der Landeszentralle für politische Bildung NRW mitfinanziert Immerhin redet Peter Krieg nicht maschinenstürmenden Babybolschewiken das Wort und gibt es ihnen auch nicht sondern versucht an vorderster Front Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen Jesco von Puttkamer deutschstämmiger NASA Direktor erläutert seine Fantasien vom Menschen im Weltall Menschen lieben den Kampf Menschen brauchen einen Feind also warum nicht die Eroberung des Weltalls als völkereinigenden Krieg betreiben Diese etwas altbackenen Träume eines Wernher von Braun Imitats werden mit raffiniert gefilmten Maschinen konfrontiert von „Maschinenkünstlern“ wie Jim Whiting oder Shunichi Mizuno entworfen Die seltsam befremdenden Schauspielpuppen des Japaners Mizuno vollführen ohne jede Gefühlsregung menschliche Tätigkeiten während Jim Whitings pressluftbetriebener „Vogelapparat“  der weder mit Mensch noch Tier die geringste Ähnlichkeit hat  heftige Emotionen beim Betrachter auszulösen vermag ein bedrohlich umsich schlagendes Monster das sich schon im nächsten Moment zu einer behindertmitleiderregenden Kreatur verwandeln kann Wirklich aufregend aber die Einblicke in das Denken führender Wissenschaftler die wie Wesen aus visionären ScienceFictions über die Zukunft fabulieren Marvin Minsky einer der Väter der artificial intelligence vom Bostoner MIT „Eines Tages wenn wir wissen wie der Verstand arbeitet werden wir begreifen daß es nicht notwendig ist krank zu sein oder im Alter das Gedächntis zu verlieren oder zu sterben Man kann dann alle Elemente seiner Persönlichkeit in einen anderen Körper einen Maschinenkörper verpflanzen der erhalten wird und kontinuierlich wächst so daß wir nicht auf ewig mit unseren Begrenzungen leben müssen Das hat auch Faust verstanden aber er hatte natürlich unrecht in seinem Fall denn er handelte mit dem Teufel Aber wir handeln mit Maschinen und das ist ein wenig neutraler und die Möglichkeiten sind vielversprechender“ Einerseits wissen wir Alles was man tut oder getan hat jede gottverdammte Aktivität führt unweigerlich zu einem faulenden Fleischklumpen Früher oder später Meistens früher Und dann fabuliert jemand wie Marvin Minsky von der vielleicht bald möglichen Unsterblichkeit Wären da nicht immer wieder Kriegs wichtigtuerische Quasseleien über „Seelenlagen“ und „Primärgefühle“ dieser Film hätte Zukunftsmodelle auf eindringliche Art vor Augen führen können So aber bleibt es bei gutgemeinter Seelenmassage für linke Träumer Torsten Alisch Peter Krieg Maschinenträume
translation: This ambitious film about the future of mankind is a strange hybrid On the one hand, Peter Krieg's intellectual-religious loquaciousness gets on one's nerves, but then every now and then he lets people have their say whose fantastic visions one would like to listen to longer Krieg's thesis that we are only able to recognise the true meaning of technology as a wish and fear machine when we are ready to "perceive our inner reality of feelings" sounds like fashionable New Age. "are prepared to perceive our inner reality of feelings" sounds like fashionable New Age No less enervating is a stylised "dreamer" who appears every few minutes in the film and is connected to all kinds of technical devices with cables and tubes - a clumsy, cheap copy of the kind that only a German filmmaker could come up with to "illustrate" his theses in a preachy manner. The film was co-financed by television and the Landeszentralle für politische Bildung NRW At least Peter Krieg doesn't give the word to machine-storming baby Bolsheviks and doesn't give it to them either, but tries to gain knowledge on the front line Jesco von Puttkamer, NASA director of German descent, explains his fantasies of man in space People love the fight People need an enemy So why not pursue the conquest of space as a war to unite peoples These somewhat old-fashioned dreams of a Wernher von Braun imitation are confronted with cleverly filmed machines designed by "machine artists" such as Jim Whiting or Shunichi Mizuno The strangely alienating mannequins of the Japanese Mizuno perform human activities without any emotion while Jim Whiting's Jim Whiting's compressed air-powered "bird apparatus", which bears no resemblance to either humans or animals, is capable of triggering strong emotions in the viewer - a menacing, flailing monster that can transform into a handicapped, pitiful creature in the very next moment What is really exciting, however, are the insights into the thinking of leading scientists who, like creatures from visionary science fiction, fantasise about the future. Marvin Minsky, one of the fathers of artificial intelligence from MIT in Boston "One day when we know how the mind works we will realise that it is not necessary to be sick or to lose your memory or to die in old age You can then transplant all the elements of your personality into another body a machine body that will be preserved and grow continuously so that we are not forever with our limitations. we don't have to live with our limitations forever Faust understood that too but he was wrong in his case of course because he was dealing with the devil But we are dealing with machines and that is a little more neutral and the possibilities are more promising" On the one hand we know everything you do or have done every god damn activity inevitably leads to a rotting lump of flesh Sooner or later Mostly sooner And then we fade away. And then someone like Marvin Minsky fables about immortality, which may soon be possible If it weren't for war's pompous blather about "soul situations" and "primary feelings", this film could have demonstrated models for the future in a vivid way But it remains a well-intentioned soul massage for left-wing dreamers Torsten Alisch Peter Krieg Machine dreams

text: Berlin taz — Nicht nur im irakisch besetzten Kuwait sondern in der gesamten Region gehören Menschenrechtsverstöße zum Alltag — ohne daß dies in den vergangenen Jahren Anlaß zu einer Neuorientierung der Politik gewesen wäre schreibt amnesty international ai in einer Dokumentation die eine Woche vor Ablauf des UNUltimatums an den Irak veröffentlicht wird Amnesty kritisiert die unterschiedlichen Maßstäbe die von Regierungen in den USA und Europa je nach wirtschaftlichen politischen oder strategischen Interessen angelegt worden sind „Wer jetzt auf Menschenrechtsverletzungen des Irak verweist“ so amnesty international „muß sich fragen lassen was er vor der Annexion Kuwaits getan hat um die Menschenrechte im Irak zu schützen“ etwa als die irakische Armee im März 1988 mit Giftgasangriffen allein in der kurdischen Stadt Halabdja 5000 Menschen ermordete Iran Im Iran werden seit vielen Jahren auf gravierendste Weise Menschenrechtsverstöße begangen Im Dezember legte ai einen Bericht vor der vor allem die in den letzten drei Jahren vollzogenen mehr als 5000 Hinrichtungen beklagte Ihr fielen meist Menschen zum Opfer die das Regime als Oppositionelle bezeichnete Zwischen Juli 1988 und Januar 1989 wurden über 2000 politische Gefangene exekutiert ohne daß es auch nur den Anschein rechtsstaatlichen Vorgehens gegeben hätte Auch grauenhafte Folter gehört zum Alltag Irak Auch im Irak werden die Menschenrechte mit Füßen getreten Tausende Menschen befinden sich aus politischen Gründen in Haft darunter viele die niemals Gewalt angewendet oder befürwortet haben Tausende politisch Mißliebige sind während des achtjährigen Krieges gegen den Iran „verschwunden“ aber auch Tausende irakische Kurden wurden von den Sicherheitskräften verschleppt und sind nie wieder aufgetaucht so 1983 8000 Angehörige des kurdischen BarzaniClans Kuwait Vor der irakischen Okkupation des Emirats am 2 August kritisierte ai vor allem die Inhaftierung Oppositioneller ohne faires Verfahren Berichte sprechen von Folterungen in der Haft Unter dem Vorwurf einen Umsturz geplant zu haben sind zwischen September 1989 und Mai 1990 ungefähr 40 Kuwaitis darunter mindestens 30 Schiiten inhaftiert worden manche nur für wenige Tage andere bis zu neun Monaten Berichten zufolge sind mehrere von ihnen gefoltert worden um „Geständnisse“ zu erpressen Die meisten wurden im März 1990 ohne Anklageerhebung freigelassen Jordanien 50 Jahre lang — von 1939 bis 1989 — konnten die jordanischen Behörden vermeintliche oder tatsächliche Regierungsgegner ohne Anklage und Gerichtsverfahren in Haft halten Zu den mittlerweile freigelassenen Häftlingen gehören unter anderen Mitglieder verschiedener Oppositionsgruppen wie die Organisation der Volksfront der Jordanischen Kommunistischen Partei der PLO der Islamischen Befreiungspartei und Sympathisanten schiitischer Gruppen Sie waren alle im Hauptquartier des berüchtigten jordanischen Geheimdienstes in Haft Aus der Geheimdienstzentrale und dem gefürchteten SwaqaGefängnis sind laut ai bereits früher Berichte über Folterungen zugegangen Häufig erwähnt werden Schläge auf die Fußsohlen Peitschenhiebe und Schläge mit Kabeln Eine hinreichende Untersuchung der Übergriffe in staatlichem Gewahrsam hat es nach Kenntis von ai trotz der vorläufigen Aussetzung der Notstandsbestimmungen bis heute nicht gegeben Zwar wurden viele der Gefangenen nach der Ankündigung rechtlicher Reformen im Dezember 1989 freigelassen doch haben die Behörden nach wie vor die Möglichkeit politische Häftlinge auf unbestimmte Zeit ohne Verfahren in Haft zu halten Syrien Seit 1963 gilt in Syrien eine Notstandsgesetzgebung die den verfassungsrechtlichen Schutz von Meinungs Rede und Religionsfreiheit und das Verbot der Folter außer Kraft setzt Das Ergebnis Tausende willkürlicher Verhaftungen selten nach einer rechtskräftigen Verurteilung Viele sitzen ohne Verfahren bereits seit zwei Jahrzehnten oder länger hinter Gittern Gefährdet sind vor allem Mitglieder der Partei für Kommunistische Aktion der KP der Moslembruderschaft der DFLP der Bewegung Islamische Einheit und der proirakischen ArabischSozialistischen BaathPartei Zum Vorwurf der Folter und Mißhandlung schweigt die Regierung obwohl in Syrien systematisch unter körperlichen Torturen verhört wird Elektroschocks Schläge auf die Fußsohlen Auspeitschungen und zahlreiche andere Foltermethoden sind üblich SaudiArabien Wer in Saudi Arabien in den Verdacht der politischen Opposition gerät riskiert Haft und Folter Von 1983 bis 1989 wurden ai über 700 solche Fälle bekannt Betroffen sind vor allem Sympathisanten schiitischer Oppositionsgruppen Politische Parteien und Gewerkschaften sind in SaudiArabien verboten In den ersten Tagen der Haft wird geradezu routinemäßig mißhandelt oder gefoltert Schläge auf die Fußsohlen Aufhängen an den Handgelenken Schlafentzug Elektroschocks und Schläge auf den ganzen Körper sind üblich und führten in einigen Fällen zum Tod der Gefangenen Erschreckende Ausmaße hat der Terror seit Ausbruch der Golfkrise insbesondere gegen jemenitische Fremdarbeiter angenommen Seit dem 19 September werden sie systematisch vertrieben Hunderte mußten in behelfsmäßig eingerichteten Haftzentren Mißhandlungen erdulden
translation: Berlin taz - Human rights violations are part of everyday life not only in Iraqi-occupied Kuwait but in the entire region - without this having been a reason for a reorientation of policy in recent years, writes Amnesty International ai in a documentary published a week before the expiry of the UN ultimatum to Iraq Amnesty criticises the different standards applied by governments in the USA and Europe depending on economic, political or strategic interests "Anyone who now refers to human rights violations by Iraq", says Amnesty International, "must ask himself What did they do to protect human rights in Iraq before the annexation of Kuwait?" For example, when the Iraqi army murdered 5,000 people in the Kurdish city of Halabdja alone with poison gas attacks in March 1988 Iran In Iran, human rights violations have been committed in the most serious manner for many years. December, ai presented a report which above all deplored the more than 5,000 executions carried out in the last three years Most of the victims of these executions were people whom the regime described as members of the opposition Between July 1988 and January 1989, more than 2,000 political prisoners were executed without even the appearance of the rule of law. Iraq Human rights are also trampled underfoot in Iraq Thousands of people are imprisoned for political reasons, including many who have never used or advocated violence Thousands of political dissidents are imprisoned during the eight-year war against Iran. thousands of Iraqi Kurds were abducted by the security forces and have never reappeared, including 8,000 members of the Kurdish Barzani clan of Kuwait in 1983 Prior to the Iraqi occupation of the emirate on 2 August, ai criticised the detention of opposition figures without a fair trial. Reports speak of torture in detention Between September 1989 and May 1990, around 40 Kuwaitis, including at least 30 Shiites, were imprisoned on charges of plotting a coup, some for only a few days and others for up to nine months. of them were reportedly tortured to extract "confessions" Most were released without charge in March 1990 Jordan For 50 years - from 1939 to 1989 - the Jordanian authorities were able to detain alleged or actual opponents of the government without charge or trial. The prisoners who have since been released include members of various opposition groups such as the Popular Front Organisation of the Jordanian Communist Party of the PLO of the Islamic Liberation Party and sympathisers of Shiite groups They were all detained at the headquarters of the notorious Jordanian secret service. According to ai, there have been previous reports of torture from the intelligence service headquarters and the dreaded Swaqa prison Frequently mentioned are beatings on the soles of the feet, lashes and beatings with cables To the best of ai's knowledge, there has been no adequate investigation into the abuses in state custody. Although many of the prisoners were released after the announcement of legal reforms in December 1989, the authorities still have the power to detain political prisoners indefinitely without trial Syria Emergency legislation has been in force in Syria since 1963, overriding the constitutional protection of freedom of speech and religion and the prohibition of torture The result of thousands of arbitrary arrests rarely after a final conviction Many have been behind bars without trial for two decades or more The most vulnerable are members of the Communist Action Party of the CP of the Muslim Brotherhood of the DFLP of the Islamic Unity Movement and the pro-Iraqi Arab Socialist Baath Party The government remains silent on allegations of torture and ill-treatment, even though interrogations in Syria are systematically carried out under physical torture. electric shocks beatings on the soles of the feet floggings and numerous other methods of torture are common in Saudi Arabia Anyone suspected of political opposition in Saudi Arabia risks imprisonment and torture From 1983 to 1989, ai became aware of over 700 such cases. Political parties and trade unions are banned in Saudi Arabia In the first few days of detention, abuse or torture is almost routine Beatings on the soles of the feet Hanging by the wrists Sleep deprivation Electric shocks and beatings all over the body are common and in some cases have led to the death of prisoners Since the outbreak of the Gulf crisis, the terror has taken on appalling proportions, especially against Yemeni foreign workers Since 19 September, they have been systematically expelled Hundreds have had to endure ill-treatment in makeshift detention centres

text: Genf taz – Den wohlklingenden Erklärungen der vor zwei Wochen beendeten Wiener Weltmenschenrechtskonferenz der UNO stellt „amnesty international“ heute mit ihrem „Jahresbericht 1993“ die harte Realität entgegen Die Folter und Mißhandlung von Gefangenen war 1992 in 110 der 186 UNOMitgliedsstaaten an der Tagesordnung In 62 Ländern – so der Bericht der heute veröffentlicht wird – wurden Frauen und Männer wegen ihrer politischen und religiösen Überzeugung oder wegen ihrer ethnischen Zugehörigkeit manchmal jahrelang ohne Gerichtsverfahren inhaftiert Und in 45 Staaten wurden Oppositionelle Opfer „staatlichen Mordes“ Für die Bundesrepublik Deutschland werden in dem Bericht „rassistisch motivierte Mißhandlungen durch Polizei und Sicherheitskräfte“ festgestellt Wobei der in der internationalen aiZentrale in London erstellte Jahresbericht in seinem Deutschlandkapitel zur Unzufriedenheit der deutschen ai Sektion zu milde ausfiel Den Regierungen wirft ai „Doppelmoral“ vor Sie führen fort „der Politik einen höheren Stellenwert einzuräumen als Menschenleben“ Die Wiener Menschenrechtskonferenz habe „lediglich die Prinzipien der Vergangenheit bestätigt anstatt sich mit den gegenwärtigen Mißbräuchen und den drohenden Gefahren auseinanderzusetzen“ Ob die Konferenz einen „Einfluß auf das Leben von Menschen“ haben werde müßten „die Regierungen erst noch beweisen“ Der Jahresbericht dokumentiert Menschenrechtsverletzungen in 161 Staaten In Asien stelle ai „kaum Anzeichen“ für eine Verbesserung der Situation fest Todesstrafen Folter unfaire Gerichtsverfahren Verschwindenlassen oder staatlicher Mord gehörten „zur täglichen Routine“ Allein für China liegen ai für 1992 verläßliche Informationen über die Verhängung von 1891 Todesurteilen und den Vollzug von 1079 Hinrichtungen vor Auf Basis „inoffizieller Quellen“ geht ai davon aus daß die tatsächlichen Zahlen noch „weit höher liegen“ In Indonesien Burma Sri Lanka und auf den Philippinen wurden Regimekritiker und Oppositionelle „weiterhin systematisch ermordet“ In Kambodscha seien die Hoffnungen auf das von der UNO vermittelte Friedensabkommen durch politisch motivierte Morde und Massaker im Vorfeld der Wahlen „erschüttert worden“ Auch in den Konfliktregionen Indiens seien „Hunderte“ Oppositionelle ermordet worden In indischen Polizeistationen wurde „systematisch gefoltert und vergewaltigt“ Obwohl immer mehr Länder in Afrika zu einem Mehrparteiensystem übergingen sei die Zahl der Menschenrechtsverletzungen auf diesem Kontinent 1992 „erschreckend hoch geblieben“ In 14 Ländern – darunter Angola Tschad Sierra Leone Sudan und Zaire – seien Tausende schutzloser Frauen Kinder und Männer „von Regierungskräften massakriert“ worden Auch in Südafrika waren die Sicherheitskräfte „weiterhin in politisch motivierte Morde verwickelt“ Nach dem Zusammenbruch der staatlichen Ordnung in Somalia „töteten vergewaltigten und verstümmelten rivalisierende politische Gruppen wahllos Zivilpersonen Für Angola Sudan und einige andere Staaten Afrikas stellt ai auch Morde und Folterungen durch „bewaffnete Oppositionsgruppen“ fest Die meisten Regierungen in Lateinamerika hätten es unterlassen die Verantwortlichen in Polizei und Armee für die nach wie vor zahlreichen Fälle „staatlichen Mordes und des Verschwindenlassens von Personen zur Rechenschaft zu ziehen“ fährt der Bericht fort In El Salvador Brasilien Kolumbien Guatemala und Peru hätten reguläre Streitkräfte paramilitärische Gruppierungen oder Todesschwadrone Tausende von Menschen darunter Hunderte von Straßenkindern und „sozial Unerwünschten“ umgebracht und seien durch weitgehende Amnestiegesetze vor Strafverfolgung geschützt worden Systematische Folter und „grausame Körperstrafen“ an Tausenden von Menschen hält der Bericht für den Iran Irak und andere Staaten im Mittleren Osten fest Im Iran wurden 1992 330 Menschen – zumeist Gewissensgefangene – hingerichtet Im Irak verschwanden seit 1988 etwa 100000 KurdInnen Europa ist laut ai 1992 „zu einem Schauplatz schwerer Menschenrechtsverletzungen geworden“ Für die Greueltaten in BosnienHerzegowina seien „alle beteiligten Kriegsparteien verantwortlich“ die Mehrheit der Opfer allerdings seien muslimische Frauen Kinder und Männer und die Mehrzahl der Täter „serbische Soldaten und Freischärler“ In den Bürgerkriegen in Aserbaidschan Tadschikistan und in anderen Gebieten der ExSowjetunion seien „Zehntausende wenn nicht Hunderttausende wegen ihrer ethnischen Zugehörigkeit gefoltert vergewaltigt und massakriert“ worden Für Frankreich Italien Portugal Spanien Rumänien Bulgarien und Deutschland verzeichnet der ai Bericht einen „Anstieg der Berichte über teilweise rassistisch motivierte Folterungen und Mißhandlungen durch die Polizei und Sicherheitskräfte“ In der Türkei war die Folter 1992 „weit verbreitet“ Die Zahl der „extralegalen Hinrichtungen“ im mehrheitlich kurdischen Südosten der Türkei sei „beträchtlich angestiegen“ Die Rettung vor solchen Praktiken durch Flucht wurde laut ai 1992 „erheblich erschwert“ – auch durch die neuen Asylgesetze und abkommen der EGStaaten und ihre „immer restriktivere Flüchtlingspolitik“ Andreas Zumach
translation: Geneva taz - The euphonious declarations of the UN World Human Rights Conference in Vienna, which ended a fortnight ago, are countered today by Amnesty International's "Annual Report 1993" with the harsh reality Torture and ill-treatment of prisoners was the order of the day in 110 of the 186 UN member states in 1992 In 62 countries - according to the report published today - women and men were sometimes imprisoned for years without trial because of their political and religious convictions or because of their ethnic affiliation And in 45 countries opposition members were victims of "state murder" For the Federal Republic of Germany, the report notes "racially motivated ill-treatment by police and security forces". Germany, the report notes "racially motivated abuses by police and security forces" The annual report prepared at the international ai headquarters in London was too lenient in its chapter on Germany, to the dissatisfaction of the German ai section ai accuses governments of "double standards" They continue to "prioritise politics over human lives" The Vienna Human Rights Conference "merely reaffirmed the principles of the past rather than addressing current abuses and imminent dangers" Whether the conference will have an "impact on people's lives" is a question that ai is asking. The annual report documents human rights violations in 161 countries In Asia, ai found "hardly any signs" of an improvement in the situation Death sentences Torture Unfair trials Disappearances or state murder were "part of daily routine" For China alone, ai has reliable information on the imposition of 1891 death sentences and the execution of 1079 executions in 1992 On the basis of "unofficial sources", ai assumes that the actual figures are "far higher" In Indonesia, Burma, Sri Lanka and the Philippines, the number of executions is "much higher". Sri Lanka and the Philippines, regime critics and opposition members "continued to be systematically murdered" In Cambodia, hopes for the peace agreement brokered by the UN were "shattered by politically motivated murders and massacres in the run-up to the elections" In the conflict regions of India, too, "hundreds" of opposition members were murdered. "In Indian police stations, "systematic torture and rape" took place Although more and more countries in Africa switched to a multi-party system, the number of human rights violations on this continent remained "alarmingly high" in 1992. Angola Chad Sierra Leone Sudan and Zaire - thousands of defenceless women, children and men were "massacred by government forces" In South Africa, too, the security forces "continued to be involved in politically motivated killings" After the collapse of state order in Somalia, "raped and mutilated rivals killed, murdered and murdered their victims". In Angola, Sudan and some other African states, ai also notes killings and torture by "armed opposition groups" Most governments in Latin America have failed to hold those responsible in the police and army accountable for the still numerous cases of "state murder". The report goes on to say that in El Salvador, Brazil, Colombia, Guatemala and Peru, regular armed forces, paramilitary groups or death squads have killed thousands of people, including hundreds of street children and "socially marginalised" people. street children and "social undesirables" and were protected from prosecution by extensive amnesty laws Systematic torture and "cruel corporal punishment" of thousands of people is recorded in the report for Iran, Iraq and other states in the Middle East In 1992, 330 people - mostly prisoners of conscience - were executed in Iran. In Iran, 330 people - mostly prisoners of conscience - were executed in 1992 In Iraq, around 100,000 Kurds have disappeared since 1988 According to ai, Europe "has become a theatre of serious human rights violations" in 1992 "All warring parties involved are responsible" for the atrocities in Bosnia-Herzegovina. Muslim women, children and men and the majority of the perpetrators were "Serbian soldiers and irregulars" In the civil wars in Azerbaijan, Tajikistan and other areas of the former Soviet Union, "tens of thousands if not hundreds of thousands were tortured, raped and massacred because of their ethnicity" For France Italy Portugal Spain Romania Bulgaria and Germany, the ai report records an "increase in reports of partly racially motivated torture and ill-treatment by the police and security forces" In Turkey, torture was "widespread" in 1992. executions" in the predominantly Kurdish south-east of Turkey had "risen considerably" According to ai, escaping from such practices by fleeing became "considerably more difficult" in 1992 - also due to the new asylum laws and agreements of the EC states and their "increasingly restrictive refugee policies" Andreas Zumach

Türkiye’de 6 Mayıs’ta “terör örgütü üyeliği“ suçlamasıyla tutuklanan Alman vatandaşı gazeteci Meşale Tolu Çarşamba günü ilk kez hakim karşısına çıktı Yasadışı MarksistLeninist Komünist Parti MLKP üyelerinin cenaze ve anmalarına katıldığı gerekçesiyle “terör örgütü propagandası yapmak“ ve “terör örgütüne üye olmak“ iddiasıyla yargılanan Tolu savunmasında OHAL’de ifade ve basın özgürlüğü ile tüm demokratik hakların ortadan kaldırıldığını belirtti Mahkeme Meşale Tolu ile birlikte 6 sanığın tutukluluğunun devamına karar verirken serbest foto muhabir Ulaş Ömer Sezgin’in de aralarında bulunduğu 8 kişinin tahliyesine hükmetti Kararın ardından gazetemize konuşan Meşale Tolu’nun ablası Gülay Tolu “Siyasi bir karar Meşale tahliye edilenlerden farklı bir şeyle yargılanmıyor Almanyadaki seçim çalışmalarında Meşaleyi ananları bugün burada göremedik görmek isterdik“ dedi Meşale Tolu ile 17 sanığın “terör örgütü üyeliği“ suçlamasıyla yargılandığı davanın ilk duruşması İstanbul’daki Silivri Adliyesi’nde görüldü Duruşmayı Almanya Sol Parti Parlamenterler Grubu Başkan Yardımcısı Heike Hänsel HDP Milletvekili Erdal Ataş ve HDP Eş Genel Başkan Yardımcısı Beycan Taşkıran ile Almanya ve Türkiye basınından birçok gazeteci izledi 
Bilgiyi iletmek suç sayıldı’
 Duruşma öncesi Meşale’nin babası Ali Rıza Tolu mahkeme önünde yaptığı açıklamada “Kızım terör örgütü üyeliğinden yargılanıyor Bunlar mesnetsiz ETHA ve Özgür Radyo’da çalışıp çevirmenlik yaptı Cenazelere katılmayı suç sayıyorlar Bilgiyi iletmeyi suç sayıyorlar Kızımın 3 yaşında çocuğu var Serbest kalacağına inanıyorum“ dedi Bu sırada jandarma basın açıklamasına müdahale etti 
Mahkeme başkanı tutuklamaya karar veren hakim
 Duruşmanın başında avukatlar mahkeme heyeti başkanı Mustafa Çakarın soruşturmanın da sorgu hakimi olduğunu hatırlattı Avukatlar Çakar’ın CMK’ye göre bu davayı yürütemeyeceğini belirtip çekilmesini istedi Mahkeme heyeti ise bu talebi reddetti Duruşmada savunma yapan Meşale Tolu iddianamede hakkında ifade veren gizli tanığın“ kendisinin ismini dahi bilmediğine dikkat çekti Gizli tanığın ifadesinde “terör örgütünün Gazi Mahallesi yapılanması“ içerisinde yer aldığını söylediğini hatırlatan Tolu bahsi geçen 20142015 yıllarında çoğunlukla Almanya’da olduğunu ve hamilelik süreci yaşadığını söyledi Ailesi ile birlikte İstanbul Kartal’da yaşadığını kaydeden Tolu 5 aylık bir çocukla her gün KartalGazi Mahallesi arasında yolu gidip gelme suçlamasını absürt bulduğunu Gazi Mahallesi’ne hayatında sadece 4 kez gittiğini ve bu nedenle gizli tanık ifadesinin asılsız olduğunu söyledi 
Basına yönelik saldırıların bir parçası’
 2014 ve 2015 yıllarında katıldığı cenaze töreni ve basın açıklamalarının bugün suç sayıldığına dikkat çeken Tolu OHAL’de ifade ve basın özgürlüğü ile tüm demokratik hakların ortadan kaldırıldığını söyledi Tolu bu dönemde KHK ile kapatılan basın kuruluşları ile tutuklanan gazetecilere dikkat çekti ve gazeteciliğin zor dönemlerde iktidarların daha fazla hedefinde olduğunu belirtti Tolu ETHA’ya yönelik suçlamalara ilişkin “ETHA kamuoyunu bilgilendirme görevini yerine getirmiştir“ dedi Tolu serbest foto muhabiri Ulaş Ömer Sezgin ile birlikte tutuklanmalarının sebebinin basına yönelik saldırıların bir parçası olduğunu söyledi 
Cenazeye katılmak din ve vicdan meselesi’
 Hakkındaki diğer suçlamalara da yanıt veren Tolu “IŞİD’e karşı savaşırken ölenlerin cenazesine katılmak suç değildir Kaldı ki NATO üyesi olan Türkiye de IŞİD’e karşıdır“ dedi Tolu eylemlere katılmanın düşünce ve ifade özgürlüğü cenazelere katılmanın da din ve vicdan meselesi olduğunu vurguladı 
Çocuğu da cezalandırılıyor
 Eşinin de kendisinden kısa süre önce tutuklandığını belirten Tolu 55 aydır çocuğu ile birlikte hapiste olduğunu bu durumda çocuğunun da cezalandırıldığını söyledi Savcılık tarafından ifadeye çağrılması durumunda gidebilecekken tutuklu yargılandığını belirten Tolu tahliyesini talep etti Meşale Tolu’nun avukatlarından Kader Tonç da savunmasında “Mahkeme başkanı tarafsızlığını yitirmiştir Kovuşturma aşaması tıpkı soruşturma gibi hukuka aykırı başlamıştır“ dedi 23 yıl öncesine ait cenaze törenlerine katılmanın suç sayıldığını kaydeden Tonç “Hatun Tuğluk’un cenazesine saldıran zihniyet ile bu cenazelere katılmayı kriminalize eden zihniyet aynıdır“ ifadelerini kullandı Savunmaların ardından mütalaasını açıklayan savcı sanıkların tutukluluğunun devamını istedi Mahkeme heyeti verilen aradan sonra Meşale Tolu ile birlikte 6 sanığın kaçma şüphesi olduğu iddiasıyla tutukluğunun devamına karar verdi Tutuklu yargılanan 8 sanığın ise tahliyesine karar verildi Bir sonraki duruşma 18 Aralık günü Çağlayan Adliyesinde görülecek
